channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Transfer Family now supports source IP preservation for SFTP servers behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB)
item.description: AWS Transfer Family now preserves the client's source IP address using Proxy Protocol v2 (PPv2) when you place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of your SFTP server that uses a VPC-hosted endpoint. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports IAM session policies
item.description: AWS HealthOmics now supports IAM session policies, enabling you to restrict permissions for individual runs without creating and managing multiple IAM roles. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Batch now supports bulk job cancellation and termination
item.description: AWS Batch now supports bulk job cancellation and termination, enabling you to cancel or terminate up to 50 jobs with a single API call. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 T8i instances
item.description: AWS is announcing the general availability of new low-cost burstable Amazon EC2 T8i instances. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk introduces Cluster Mode to run multiple applications on shared infrastructure
item.description: AWS Elastic Beanstalk introduces Cluster Mode, a new deployment mode that lets you run and manage multiple applications on shared infrastructure in your account. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon S3 Express One Zone is now available in 7 additional AWS Regions
item.description: The Amazon S3 Express One Zone storage class is now available in 7 additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Singapore), South America (Sao Paulo), US West (N. (1 source: aws)
